world.title: 引力助推改变飞船的速度
world.posterTitle: 飞船如何不烧燃料，向行星「借」速度？
world.posterHook: 选择后方或前方掠过行星，亲眼看 Δv 为正还是为负；再切到旋转参考系，找引力刚好抵消的 5 个点。
world.posterSource: Canvas 2D · 限制性三体数值积分 · 本地构建
world.question: 引力弹弓为什么能「白捡」速度？
world.hook: 调节飞掠高度发射飞船，看轨迹被行星掰弯；再把粒子放到拉格朗日点，看 L4 被锁住、L1 漂走。
world.payoff: 弹弓效应借的是行星的轨道动能：后方掠过被行星拖着走而加速，前方掠过则减速。拉格朗日点是旋转系中引力与离心力的平衡位置，L4/L5 稳定（特洛伊小行星），L1/L2/L3 需要点火维持。

en.title: A gravity assist changes a spacecraft’s speed
en.posterTitle: How can a spacecraft "borrow" speed from the planet without burning fuel?
en.posterHook: Choose to fly behind or in front of the planet and see with your own eyes whether Δv is positive or negative; then switch to the rotating reference frame and find 5 points where the gravity just cancels out.
en.posterSource: Canvas 2D · Restricted three-body numerical integration · Local construction
en.question: Why can the gravity slingshot gain speed for free?
en.hook: Adjust the flyby altitude to launch the spacecraft and watch the trajectory be bent by the planet; then place the particles at the Lagrangian point and watch L4 be locked and L1 float away.
en.payoff: The slingshot effect borrows the orbital kinetic energy of the planet: it accelerates when it passes behind and is dragged along by the planet, and it slows down when it passes in front. The Lagrangian point is the equilibrium position of gravity and centrifugal force in the rotating system. L4/L5 are stable (Trojan asteroids), and L1/L2/L3 require ignition to maintain.
